reason: The prior China-Russia hypothesis is contradicted by actual deployments: Russia has offered condolences without a team and China has only conditionally offered help. The US is immediately sending search-and-rescue teams, Venezuela specifically requested Mexican specialists, and its government says US, Mexican and Spanish aid is en route. Host-plus-foreign cooperation is also more common than two self-contained foreign teams jointly conducting one extraction.

Norrie is confirmed as the only British men's seed, so he must draw an unseeded first-round opponent; this sharply weakens prior seeded candidates such as Arthur Fils and likely Michelsen/Fonseca. Before the draw, even dangerous unseeded players warrant only low-single-digit probabilities among roughly 96 eligible opponents. Draper is the strongest named unseeded threat after returning from injury, while Hijikata's Queen's upset supplies current grass form.

Mercedes brings an upgrade and Antonelli has a fresh power unit at a circuit he says better suits the car than Barcelona; McLaren concedes it still lacks race-ready upgrades. Hamilton has two seconds and a win in his last three starts and is now the clearest challenger, while Russell remains a substantial Mercedes path.
